environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with public ALB, no authentication middleware on the GraphQL endpoint, introspection enabled, CDN_BASE_URL pointing to a public CDN without integrity verification. Container runs with default memory limits (no OOM kill threshold). No rate limiting on queries. The /explorer endpoint serves scripts from CDN without SRI attributes.

config.network: public subnet, no NACLs restricting inbound
